tool_config.name: register_asset
tool_config.description: Register something she owns for her business. Ask what it is and roughly what it is worth in naira. No money moves; no confirm needed.

type.description: stock, tools, machine, motorcycle or livestock (her words are fine: okada, goats, generator).

description.description: A few words: "stall stock, tomatoes", "okada for deliveries".

value.description: Rough value in whole naira, digits only ("90000").
